items.item_text: Valid and current California Certified Phlebotomy Technician I certificate (CT PHLEBOT)
High school and/or college chemisty, biology, or mathematics are highly desired

Processes, collects, and transports specimens from patients of all ages in an accurate and safe manner; including: Successful venipuncture rates from approved phlebotomy sites using approved techniques.
Accepts organizational and logistical direction from more experienced phlebotomists.
Plates microbiology specimens on appropriate primary culture media according to established procedures; including: Complete and accurate specimen identification.

Is proficient in the use of the laboratory computer system and individual instrument computers as necessary. These duties include, but are not limited to the following: Monitoring Collection Batches for rounds. The hard copy of the TIMED category must be reviewed and highlighted, and discrepancies resolved.
Do rounds 5 minutes after the hour. Monitoring OE interface printer. Includes resolving ADDS and CANCELLED tests. Sign-off on each order.
Must be able to work in a calm and conscientious manner under high volumn and STAT conditions.
Basic communication skills and the ability to be caring and personable with patients are mandatory.
Rigid accuracy in the identification of patient names and numbers and the ability to perform phlebotomy successfully using established procedures on patients of all ages
